zh-CN.name: Impeccable
zh-CN.shortDesc: 让 AI 更懂设计的前端设计语言：覆盖 UX 审查、视觉层级、可访问性、排版、配色、动效与可复用设计系统，把界面打磨到生产级。新版本使用上游独立二进制启动器，可能在首次运行时下载；需自行满足平台与运行权限。可选的图像草图在设置 OPENAI_API_KEY 时可回退调用 OpenAI 图像 API，费用计入运营者自有账户。

en-US.name: Impeccable
en-US.shortDesc: A design language that makes AI better at frontend: UX review, visual hierarchy, accessibility, typography, color, motion and reusable design systems. Uses an upstream standalone binary launcher that may download on first run; platform and execution permissions must be supplied separately. Optional image comps can fall back to OpenAI's image API when OPENAI_API_KEY is set, billed to the operator's own account.
